title: Greg Hunt
text:
About


I am an interdisciplinary researcher who builds scientific tools. I am trained as a statistician, mathematician, and computer scientist. My work focuses on statistical methodology, applied data analysis, reproducible computing, and scientific software, with applications across biology, physics, engineering, and related scientific domains.
